SELECT DISTINCT NDC.[NDC_UPC_HRI_CD] AS NDC_CODE, OLD_NDC_UPC_HRI_CD,NDC.CREATE_DTTM,PRC.UPDT_DTTM, NDC.INACTIVE, CASE WHEN NDC.CREATE_DTTM < MIN(PRC.PRICE_EFF_DATE) THEN NDC.CREATE_DTTM ELSE MIN(PRC.PRICE_EFF_DATE) END AS 'EFFECTIVE_DT' ,CASE WHEN NDC.INACTIVE <> 'N' THEN CAST(PRC.UPDT_DTTM AS DATE) ELSE CAST('2099-01-01 00:00:00' AS DATE) END AS 'TERM_DT' FROM [ODW].[DW].[AGP_MEDSPN_NDC] NDC  JOIN (SELECT NDC_UPC_HRI_CD, MIN(PRICE_EFF_DATE) AS 'PRICE_EFF_DATE', MAX(UPDT_DTTM) AS 'UPDT_DTTM'        FROM [ODW].[DW].[AGP_MEDSPN_PRC] PRC GROUP BY NDC_UPC_HRI_CD) AS PRC ON PRC.[NDC_UPC_HRI_CD] = NDC.[NDC_UPC_HRI_CD]  GROUP BY NDC.[NDC_UPC_HRI_CD],OLD_NDC_UPC_HRI_CD, NDC.INACTIVE, NDC.CREATE_DTTM, PRC.PRICE_EFF_DATE,PRC.UPDT_DTTM
